g: (vulgar, Internet slang, originally African-American Vernacular) To enjoy (something) to a high degree.
i fw this cat heavy vro
(chiefly manga) A generic sound for movement, or for something appearing.
The sound of a rocket (or similar) taking off.
The sound effect of something swelling up or inflating, usually with air or helium, like a balloon.
Being puffed up or inflated, most often with air.
(chiefly pornographic manga) The sound of skin slapping against skin during sex.
(in comic books) Representing a quick motion.
(uncommon) The sound of a dull impact; the sound of (something) hitting the ground after a fall; the sound of a thud or thump.
